decisions.reason: The electronic church-motif music box fits the firm's established Christmas craft line and its move toward adding technology, and seasonal products of this kind usually stay in the catalogue for several years.
A wooden nativity stable is an evergreen core product with steady seasonal demand and complements the firm's nativity accessories, so dropping it after one year is unlikely.

The modern incense smoker suits the firm's strategy of pairing traditional craft with contemporary design, though designs in this category are somewhat more likely to be rotated out if sales disappoint.
